display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (NREM): (Apneas with >= 2% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and >= 2% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal) / hour of NREM sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in NREM sleep (>= 2% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hnrbp2 + hnrop2 + canbp2 + canop2 + oanbp2 + oanop2 + manrbp2 + manrop2)/(slpprdp - minremp)
